task_description: Create/edit a coherent Spring Boot `qa` profile (application-qa.yml) for every FIND-U microservice and lambda so they run on Railway with NO Eureka and NO Config Server: disable Eureka where the eureka-client dependency exists, keep spring.config.import optional, take all connections from environment variables, use server.port ${PORT:<expose-port>}, and for the api-gateway route by Railway internal DNS instead of lb://. Includes exactly ONE mechanical Java change in findu-core to extract a hardcoded notification-processor URL to a @Value property. No other business-logic/Java changes.
